items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Fine dies. She goes. Dive another baby.

ctx.x: You. Have any children? Children. Children? Children? No, not living in there. Fine dies. She goes. Dive another baby. And one of the last ones, she was, oh, about a couple of hours. And I smothered. Doctor thought she had to show my wife, you know, for a particular day, I look at her baby, so big it turned over. I went to find out a baby laying on his face, and I called the doctor, you know, to try to burble, breast, and do everything. It's too long, she lay there too long, you know. That's my size, but I've…
Girls would be digging from them. Right, yeah. I thought we might ask who he was playing with when his children were born, you know.
